title: Dua for Relief from Poverty & Ailments

blocks.x: Tenth: Al-Kaf’ami has reported that a man complained to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) about poverty, misery, and ailment. The Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) thus instructed him to repeat this supplicatory utterance ten times every morning and evening. As the man persevered in carrying out the Prophet’s instruction for three days, he was saved from poverty and ailment.
Shaykh al-Tusi and others mentioned the same supplicatory utterance to be said after the Dawn Prayers:

لا حَوْلَ وَلا قُوَّةَ اِلّا بِاللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى الْحَىِّ الَّذى لا يَمُوتُ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَريكٌ فِى الْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِىُّ مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبيرا
